title: Lord Jesus Think on Me
description: Lord Jesus Think on Me in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 7 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Synesius of Cyrene, first published in 430. The English translation is by Allen William Chatfield (1876). The tune, SOUTHWELL, is from William Daman's Psalter, 1579. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Lord Je-sus, think on me And purge a-way my sin; From earth-born pas-sions set me free And make me pure with-in.

lines: From earthborn passions set me free
Let me Thy loving servant be
In all my pain and misery
Be Thou my Health and Life.
When on doth rush the enemy,
That, when the flood is past,
And share Thy joy at last.
D Lord Jesus, think on me
To Father, Spirit, and to Thee
The strains of praise and love.
